Q8060.reason: Austin, author of The Province of Jurisprudence Determined, defined jurisprudence as the philosophy of positive law (sovereign command backed by sanction).

Q8095.reason: At two months the infant is still in the indiscriminate phase and accepts any adult; stranger wariness begins only around six or seven months.

Q5546.reason: The fire was accidental and the smoke came from careless storage of flammable residue, so recovery is for breach of reasonable care rather than an intentional invasion.
